fields.Name: T2p -> S2.6
fields.Description: Gate G2.24 (phase 2, dataset T2p, criterion S2.6): in new-entity mode 0 entity keys are shared between training and holdout (the reference: sharedKeys=0 on 7,000 / 600 rows), and 0 between inner-CV training and validation folds. The T2p unit declares EntityKey as its group key (2,000 entities over 12,000 rows); the shared keys are measured from the stored manifest's group keys (the newest 30% of entities held out whole from the year cutoff), and the run's new-entity report must equal that partition; the fold half is the pytest nodes tests/test_folds.py::test_grouped_folds_share_zero_keys_and_repeat and ::test_blocked_time_folds_keep_gap_and_groups. It fails when new-entity mode carves rows instead of entities (shared entity keys > 0).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 0 entity keys shared between training and the new-entity holdout, the report equal to the manifest's partition, and 0 across inner folds (2 of 2 pytest cases).
